prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred working style. I can help you pick the best fit. Quick questions to narrow it down:

- What are your primary goals? (brand awareness, lead gen, e‑commerce sales, app installs, SEO, paid media, content, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget?
- Company size and stage? (startup, SMB, enterprise)
- Any industry focus or compliance needs? (B2B tech, consumer, healthcare, finance…)
- Do you want a boutique/local agency or a larger/full‑service firm with global reach?
- Is web development or creative production required alongside marketing?

How I evaluate agencies (what you should look for)
- Relevant case studies showing measurable outcomes for businesses like yours
- Clear KPIs and reporting cadence
- Team expertise in the channels you need (SEO, paid search, social, CRO, analytics)
- Transparent pricing and scope (avoid vague retainers)
- Client references you can contact
- Cultural fit and communication style
- Experience with your tech stack (analytics, ad platforms, CMS, CRM)

Red flags
- No measurable results or only vanity metrics
- Vague strategy, promises of “guaranteed” rankings or clicks
- High staff turnover or heavy reliance on freelancers without clear oversight
- No written scope, deliverables, or reporting schedule

Next step
Tell me the answers to a few of the questions above and I’ll shortlist 3–5 San Francisco agencies matched to your needs, with why each is a good fit and questions to ask them in an intro call. If you prefer, I can also provide a checklist and email templates for vetting agencies. Which would you like?
